name: Tequemecan Valley
desc: The settlement of the tribe who live alongside the Tepetlisaurs, known as the "Children of Echoes." Whether it's the clanging of artisans' hammers or the tapping of gem hunters testing the rocks, echoing sounds can be heard throughout the canyon.

desc.text:
O craftsman who unrolls these scrolls, my name is Nare Magan Sundjatta, the 52nd chief of Nanatzcayan. I am Mbande's successor. I shall be like Daurama, Nayoga, and Sanhaj. I will weave ancient texts into a tapestry, I shall speak of the foundations of phlogiston-forging, and spare you needless detours.
…
Chapter V: Another Possibility for Phlogiston-Forging Techniques
According to the scroll left behind by our great-mother, Sakkuk, the techniques of phlogiston-forging originated from the ancient dragons. In their era, there existed a more marvelous forging method beyond present imagination, one that directly forged Phlogiston into different materials.
Such mastery was witnessed by Sakkuk, and the founding pioneer, Ixquieh, earned her title as "Hero of the Forged Flame" by truly understanding how to smelt phlogiston itself. She was no dragon — but having had no parents to grant her a name, she named herself in draconic tongue and style. So in theory, mastery of this advanced phlogiston-forging art was within human reach.
Regrettably, Ixquieh's manuscripts number few and far between. She set fire to her own workshop, including her writings about forging, and took her own life while forcing her brother do the same, to avoid his leaving a tarnished legacy like that of Och-Kan. In a sense, it was she who slew her own kin, Teteocan's first chief. I cannot pass judgment on that choice, as each era has its morals. Yet the loss of such craftsmanship is regretful, and haunts future smiths still.
The 13th chief, Hun Toh, — may fire bless his name — spent his entire life trying to grasp the art of phlogiston-forging, but found no success. I tried it in my youth and failed as well. To you, smiths of future ages: You may try, but do not squander your years and strength. For weaving matter with phlogiston is like building an unshakable house from ground Grainfruit dust, all while tracking the placement of each speck. One misstep, and the entire structure will collapse. Based on my experience, with our current technological constraints, ordinary humans cannot attain this great endeavor. Therefore, I advise you to focus on using phlogiston as a supplementary material for tempering metals and jade rather than treating it as the foundational substrate of your forging.
But this does not spell our defeat, nor our inability to surpass our ancestors and the ancient dragons. Remember, phlogiston is but a tool, and as a craftsman, it is your hand that guides the tool, not the other way around. After all, only a craftsman — you, a human — can materialize ideas and concepts into reality.
In fact, many recorded ideas from Sakkuk's time have been realized by now, even though no smith in these centuries has ever mastered the forging of phlogiston itself. Take, for instance, golden discs that preserve song and melody, platforms suspended briefly aloft by phlogiston, or vehicles that may carry us over all manner of terrain. Such marvels abound! Future generations of craftsmen — may they live in peaceful times — might build upon these techniques to achieve wonders beyond our era's imagination. This is the legacy of Nanatzcayan: A "blessing" born of mortal hands, not the boon of gods or masters.
…

"Welcome, guest from afar. Whatever light you come seeking, the Children of Echoes will respond with sincerity as solid and steady as the stones and as hot as the fires of the forge."
"In accordance with Chief Pacal's decree, all tribal matters will be announced here. (Note: Remember to tear down the old notices soon!)"

"Super great news! The next Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is starting soon, and many of our young warriors will represent our tribe in the war!"
"Participants include: The popular "Drillbit Dancer" Itzna, the veteran Tlaco, the biggest bro of the miner bros Kwila, our god of cooking Cempoa..."
"In addition, everyone's eyes will be on the renowned legendary contestant, the 'Sand Dagger of Seit'aad' Amuru as he embarks on another journey!"
"And his old rival, the 'Calamity of Tetlahuitl' Nkunga has sharpened his axe and is hot on his heels!"
"And that's not even close to all — another familiar face, the holder of an Ancient Name, Kachina, will also take part once more! We hope she'll do great this time! We hope everyone will cheer them on with all you've got!"
"To guests from afar (Note: Remember not to tear this down again!) — This is known as the Stage Tepetl, and is where we usually hold dance competitions."
"If that interests you, why not just hop up on stage and dance with us?"
"In addition, just over the bridge is Muhuru's Gemporium. If you want to purchase any gemstone accessories, there's no better place!"
"For large-scale ore and mineral trading: Take a right and head up along the stairs. Negotiate directly with Chief Pacal."
"On the other side of the steps is the Macuahuitl Workshop. If you need some seriously sturdy tools or weapons, you can't go wrong with them! Chief-approved!"
"Finally, whatever light you come seeking, the Children of Echoes will respond with sincerity as solid and steady as the stones and as hot as the fires of the forge. May your path shine brighter than gemstones."

"The Children of Echoes has 19 mining teams, of which 12 have fixed tasks within the tribe. 7 teams are available to be hired for mining or excavation tasks outside the tribe..."
"If you are interested in hiring a mining team, please prepare all the necessary documents before discussing the matter with Chief Pacal."
"We don't really like handling documents, and aren't too fussed with the details of various commercial terms. We trust that you aren't going to be too petty, play dirty, or try to take advantage of us."
"Otherwise, we'll see you at Chasca's mediation table. Deals that end in discord are no good for anyone!"

"The results of the 127751st Drillbit Dance daily dance-off have been announced! Itzna has won the crown, marking her 200th win in the daily dance-off!"
"Children of Echoes, let hear you make some noise! The next time we see Itzna, lift her onto your shoulders, throw her into the sky, and celebrate her success!"
"In addition, Zacatula and Tlaco have now participated in the competition for 1200 and 1700 total days respectively! Give it up for our two old friends!"
"And as for you youngsters watching the dancers from offstage, how can you still stay still?"
"Get up on the stage, and dance, dance, dance! Become a member of the Drillbit Dance! Show us your courage and resolve, and you can also become a legend of the stage!"

"Smash it all!"
"Smash unchanging scenery, smash ordinary, dull colors, smash the regular, ordered life that lulls you into complacency and puts you to sleep!"
"Pick up your spray cans, and fill every flat wall, cliff face, and rock wall with the fruits of your imagination! The Graffiti Alliance is ready and waiting for you to join!"
"If you're interested in graffiti, drop by the Masters of the Night-Wind to register and join at any time! Find your crew, grab your gear, and let's go go go!"
"Welcome to Muhuru's Gemporium. We sell all kinds of accessories, weapons, and tools, and are happy to accept requests to cut and polish gemstones. Be sure to clearly describe your requirements."

"If none of the gemstone designs we provide catch your fancy, clients are welcome to provide their own processing blueprints."
"Manager Cheven and her apprentice Imix both accept custom design orders. Depending on the complexity of the request, it may take anywhere between two weeks to two months."
"In addition, from time to time our store will release special gemstone designs personally cut and polished by Xilonen herself. Quantities are limited, so get them while supplies last."
"If you're interested in purchasing one, be sure to keep an eye on our shelves!"
"As for ads like 'Muhuru's Gemporium has been a trusted seller for over a century, guaranteed genuine or get 10 times your money back'... We have no need for them."
"As the previous manager said: 'If our store sells a single fake or even anything low-quality, then feel free to take a hammer and smash every single gem we've got!'"
"Anyway, if you've already found a great gem, we offer polishing and cutting services. We'll process the gem any way you like, in any style you want."
"Just don't ask us to 'carve it into the shape of a Grainfruit' or something like that. Anything else is fine!"
"To support the contestants in the upcoming Pilgrimage, our shop is offering a limited 20% off promotion."
"During the promotion, profits from all sales will be donated to support the warriors representing the Children of Echoes."
"Of course, while we're cutting our prices, rest assured we're not cutting back on the quality of our gemstone cuts!"

"Safety first! Safety first! Bravery and perseverance are important, but they're no match for falling rocks! Always wear your helmet while working, and never underestimate the importance of Article 1 of the Safety Regulations!"
"Also, playing loud music is not permitted in dangerous work areas! When you hear anything that sounds like trouble, report it immediately to help ensure the safety of the entire site!"

"Thank you, 'Uthabiti' Kachina!"
"The unstable rocks you discovered before have already been taken care of, and no property damage or injuries occurred."
"Though you left without saying a word, we all know you're a really enthusiastic and strong young lady!"
"We'll all be rooting for you this Pilgrimage! Buck up, and don't think about the past! We're with you all the way!"

...
"Article 3: When using power drills or other powered mining equipment, gloves are mandatory, and be sure to wear work pants, knee guards, and boots to fully protect your legs!"
"No matter how uncomfortable the knee guards are, you may not remove them in the mines! If you injure your joints, chances are you won't be able to leave the mines at all!"
"If any of your protective gear is damaged, please report it immediately."
...
"Article 9: Make sure you have consumed the proper amount of food, oil, salt, and fluids in accordance with regulations before entering the mines."
"Make sure you've got enough calories to burn, so you can maintain normal functionality in all areas. This is not only for taking care of your own body, but also for the sake of your entire crew!"
"Should the miners in key positions not be able to complete their production operations in accordance with safety procedures due to physical issues, it could lead to a major accident, resulting in potentially life-threatening hazards for the entire crew!"
"So, be sure to eat well before going down into the mine! Have two, three, as many servings as you need — it's not like the tribe's cafeteria's gonna run out of food! The Children of Echoes has never and will never be stingy with you!"
...
"Article 133: Mining tools are not to be disassembled or repaired without authorization. In case of a malfunction or problem, the equipment in question is to be delivered to the Macuahuitl Workshop!"
"And definitely don't go thinking the mining tools safe operation limits are set too low, or that they aren't up to the task, and make your own personal 'super modifications' to them..."
"Last time, one of the crew adjusted the drill's power to three times the normal output... He's still in the hospital recovering, and we don't have any indication when his bones will mend or his hearing will recover."
"If you're still not convinced, why not go have a chat with him yourself?"
...
"Article 145: While on breaks during the night shift, if any workers still have the extra energy, time, and mood for such things, a reminder that no dance battling is allowed in the mines!"
<color=#37ffff>Message</color> : "Why not? Afraid that if too many people dance, the mining pit'll collapse?"
<color=#37ffff>Answer</color> : "Now you're a smart Saurian cookie! But that's just part of it. The primary reason is that night dance battles are nor only allowed to take place on the Stage Tepetl."
"Besides, isn't it just a colossal waste to dance where the lighting's bad, nobody's watching, and you can't even see your own moves properly?"

<color=#37ffff>Miner's Message</color> : "I've heard that the wilds aren't very safe recently, and that monster attacks on merchant caravans are getting more and more frequent. How will that affect sales of our tribe's ores? Will it impact the incomes of our crew?"
<color=#37ffff>Another Person's Message</color> : "As for the problem with the volume of ore sales, Boss Pacal has mentioned it. The number of tourists visiting the People of the Springs has increased significantly, so they'll be importing way more raw materials than last year..."
<color=#37ffff>Another Person's Message</color> : "The Scions of the Canopy are equipping their Couriers with new gear, and they need raw metals the most. The Masters of the Night-Wind and Flower-Feather Clan are both conducting extensive building renovations, so they'll also be using a considerable amount of ores."
<color=#37ffff>Another Person's Message</color> : "As for the Collective of Plenty, trade's always been stable, and the produce from Varesa's place has gotten even cheaper, so there's no need to worry about income!"
<color=#37ffff>A Third Person's Message</color> : "I'd like to add that I've heard that all the tribes are in the middle of reorganizing their anti-monster patrols in accordance with the experience of the veterans, so the current increased threat is only temporary."
<color=#37ffff>A Third Person's Message</color> : "And so what if there's a few more monsters? We Children of Echoes happen to have more energy and zeal than we know what to do with! Put down your pickaxes and pick up your axes, we'll cut 'em all down!"

"New dining option in the miner's cafeteria available this week!"
"Combining the Jueyun Chilis from Liyue cuisine with Blazed Meat Stew, it has a fiery texture and colors bright as paint that'll give the fire in your bellies all the fuel it needs!"
"Still, all mining crew members are encouraged to only try this new dish after work, as you may need to consume inordinate amounts of water, which may be detrimental to mining work."
<color=#37ffff>Message</color> : "Spicy? Yesss, that's what I'm talking about! The Fonta-flavored Grainfruit Meat Soup Cempoa invented last time was pretty good, nice and sweet, but it wasn't very filling..."
<color=#37ffff>Answer</color> : "Thanks for you support! As for the Fonta-flavored Grainfruit Meat Soup, in light of the various different kinds of feedback received, the chefs will continue to modify and improve the dish and offer it from time to time as a specialty!"

"Lil' Saurian of the Month: Nini. Reason: 'He loves showing everyone (including foreigners) his adorable tummy!'"
"This Month's Naughtiest Lil' Saurian: Momo. Reason: 'Sharpening its teeth on Xilonen's potted plants, fighting with other Saurians in the middle of the night, stealing snacks, and hiding in Chanil's house to avoid punishment.'"
…

I am the elder of the Children of Echoes, Traore, and I leave this inscription here.
I am the storyteller of the Children of Echoes, Traore, and I leave this inscription here.
I am the shield and spear of the Children of Echoes, Traore, and I leave this inscription here.
To impart to those who will come after, and to seek instruction from the ancestors and Wayob, and to smooth out my present wrinkles.
Here I shall leave three blessings:
The first is for my friends from afar.
Let us have one more drink, Zephaniah and Irizar, you who guided the black flood here, to the place of the seal...
You do not wish me to name your deeds "heroism," for you see it as only doing your duty. You would prefer to be known as cowards, rogues, or a thorn in our side — that you should ever increase our vigilance, like an aphid that bites a Saurian.
As the storyteller, thus did I promise you, yet I must speak the truth here.
Forever and always shall you be heroes who fought alongside our tribe, the brother-kin of the Children of Echoes.
The second, is for the valiant ones who were sacrificed.
Let us have one more drink, my warriors, for we are illuminated by the Incandescent God and guided by our Chief Sundjatta, and shall not tarnish their great names.
We pray to the spirit of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, the madman who stole fire from the throat of the great dragon. To him we willingly offer up our deaths and lives, that he might block the arcane magics of the Abyss with radiant glyphs.
As an elder, I bless the warriors. May we one day be free.
May every death have meaning, for all life has a place to return.
The third, is for those who come after and read this inscription.
Let us have one more drink, those who come after, for our hope, for our future.
If you are reading this, know that the situation is dire, but that it is no time for fear.
As the shield and spear of the tribe, I bless you.
Know well that fortresses forged from the sacrifices of flesh and blood cannot stand forever, and the only true immortality is the indomitable spirit.
May you be able to win final victory.

textualResearch.title: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (III)

desc.text:
Angakuk, Angakuk.
In the Night Kingdom, I am you, and you are me. Let me see you in the mirror...
Or may you see me there instead, then place the stone with markings unerased beneath my feet.
From the mirror, place the stone beneath my feet, Angakuk.

I've had enough of this. The wooden Alpaca models I place always get knocked into all sorts of strange spots...
Could whoever it is just stop bopping them around!?
If I hadn't marked the placement spots out on the ground using graffiti, I'd have to look for them all over again…

A sign with the Saurian Relics Association's stamp on it.
It reads: "As to the survey into the feeding preferences of Flying Squirrels... It seems that they especially favor Quenepa Berries."

"The workshop is closed. No entry."
(The workshop entrance seems to be blocked by mud and rocks. It looks like there's no way to gain entry...)
The nearby area is rich in Solid Phlogiston crystals... Please be careful when moving through it.

customize.name: Saurian Claw Succulent
customize.desc: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.

customize.name: Quenepa Berry
customize.desc: Bluish, juicy berries that grow in large amounts near the Scions of the Canopy. Their shape is similar to that of Flamegranates.

customize.name: Recipe: Glittering Gemstones
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Glittering Gemstones.

customize.name: Recipe: Chocolate
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Chocolate.

customize.name: Recipe: Stuffed N' Mashed Potatoes
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Stuffed N' Mashed Potatoes.

customize.name: Overripe Flamegranate
customize.desc:
A strange Flamegranate obtained after defeating the Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King.
Normally, Flamegranates that keep growing once they have already ripened simply fall into the mud and rot. But Flamegranates that have fallen from the Mountain King's mane, perhaps owing to the unique internal temperature conditions, exhibit a rarely-seen "Overripe" state. Flamegranates in this state are stable, phlogiston-packed, brightly colored, and possess a rich and highly distinctive flavor.

customize.name: Yellow Obsidian Fragment
customize.desc: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

customize.name: Yellow Obsidian Ring
customize.desc: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

customize.name: Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King
customize.desc:
A powerful Yumkasaur that has survived both the ravages of time and countless battles, surviving until the present day.
This "Mountain King," who once joined forces with the great heroes against the Black Tide, holds a special place in the hearts of the Scions of the Canopy. Some tribe members believe that it has its current body shape because it has a unique physique, like the Qucusaurus "Tyrant"... Though in fact, this is simply because it's lived for so long, and eaten way, WAY too much.

customize.name: Tepetlisaur Whelp
customize.desc:
A young Tepetlisaurus with the ability to tunnel between rocks and solid phlogiston.
They have not yet formed the horns on their forehead, and their digging skills are still developing as well. It is even common to hear about young Tepetlisaurs getting trapped by rocks while practicing their digging. However, one day, they will grow into a form that may travel freely through even the toughest of soils.

customize.name: Tepetlisaurus
customize.desc:
A Saurian with a drill-like horn and strong claws that can tunnel through rocks and solid phlogiston.
According to legend, the ancestor of all Tepetlisaurs was a massive drake as large as a mountain, with an exceptionally long lifespan. When it slept, mountains would form along its back, and when it woke, it would shake off the dirt and rocks, leaving behind gems and jade shining amongst its scales. The huge, drill-shaped objects in the Children of Echoes are said to be the remains of that great drake's large drill-horn.

customize.name: Tepetlisaurus Warrior: Shard Striker
customize.desc:
A powerful warrior from the canyon, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.
A warrior who can strike with the power of a rockfall. Even among the Children of Echoes, who live and breathe rock and crystal, Saurian-Crowned Warriors are masters who understand rock and stone better than any. It is said they can even divine the purity and grain of the interior of raw ore merely by looking at the rough exterior.

customize.name: Tepetlisaurus Warrior: Rockbreaker Blade
customize.desc:
A powerful warrior from the canyon, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown.
A warrior who can strike with the power of a rockfall. Legend holds that the Sulfurous Veins were once a more complete and more beautiful mountain range, and it was only when the Black Tide came that the Saurian-Crowned warriors of the Children of Echoes carved the earth itself to guide the tide, giving the Veins their current appearance.

customize.name: Forged Sand Interrogator
customize.desc:
A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian who patrols the crystal mountains and rivers.
A tribal warrior wielding a ball-headed club, she can turn even the hardest of rocks into dust with her crushing blows. When not using her weapon to fight, she instead often smashes open rocks in search of precious gems and traces of phlogiston crystals.

customize.name: Forged Sand Shieldbreaker
customize.desc:
A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian that patrols the crystal mountains and rivers.
Tribal warriors wielding massive warhammers with both hands, they are the vanguard that is the first to breach the enemy's defensive lines. For the Children of Echoes, who delight in gemstones and all manner of crafted ornaments, hammers are often the first tool to be touched by the tribe's warriors as children.

customize.name: Forged Sand Javelineer
customize.desc:
A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian that patrols the crystal mountains and rivers.
In an era when the ridges were shattered and the tribes needed to rebuild, the warriors used javelins as markers to determine the locations on both sides of the canyon from which passages should be dug. That meant that each javelin had to be sunk deep into the rock.

customize.name: Rock-Cavernous Wayob Manifestation
customize.desc:
The Children of Echoes believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls.
The people of Natlan believe that the Wayob dwell in the kingdom of the Lord of the Night, and have no fixed form, instead attaching themselves to anything in order to provide guidance to lost tribespeople. Wayob manifestations are particularly special, and the figure revealed through the totems often has an important purpose.
The Children of Echoes believe that their Wayob has the power to shape mountains and valleys, and can control the echoes created when rock meets stone.

customize.name: Capybara
customize.desc:
These herbivores, which often dwell close to the water, are famous for their steely, stoic "won't even twitch if lightning strikes right next to their toes" disposition. Tourists consider them to be the paragon of animal friends.
Capybaras like to zone out while having a soak in the water, or sun themselves on the shore, and it's quite common for them to barely move for most of the day, as though not a single thing in the world could possibly perturb their calm demeanor and make them anxious. Despite their fluffy appearance, their hairs are actually quite hard and tough. If you pet them in the same direction as their coat of hair, it feels relatively smooth, but should you pet them in the opposite direction, you may end up with a scratched hand. Perhaps that is the reason even famished predators do not regard these completely harmless and quite defenseless little friends as prey...

customize.name: Flammabomb Wood
customize.desc:
Timber obtained from Flammabomb trees. Unlike what their names suggest, such timber is resistant to catching fire or exploding once processed using methods recommended by the Collective of Plenty.

Can be used to create furnishings.

customize.name: White Chestnut Oak Wood
customize.desc:
Timber obtained from White Chestnut Oak Trees. It strikes a balance between hardness and toughness, making it easy to process. Though it appears no different from most other wood, its color grows lighter once processed using methods common to the tribes of Natlan, becoming nearly white, hence the name.

Can be used to create furnishings.

customize.name: Imix
customize.desc: Artisan's apprentice from the Children of Echoes.

customize.name: Pacal
customize.desc: Chief of the Children of Echoes.

customize.name: Manqu
customize.desc: A researcher for the Saurian Relics Association, who is responsible for scholarly inquiries into certain tribal customs. The real Manqu was a craftsman who lived a thousand years ago and died during the overthrow of the tyrant Och-Kan. Now, Manqu is a phlogiston projection of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan.

customize.name: Titu
customize.desc: Storyteller of the Children of Echoes and a guard at the sentry post. The real Titu lived about 500 years ago, and then his image was used by Waxaklahun Ubah Kan.

customize.name: The Volcano Lord and the Shadow Pins
Humans and Saurians, one heart and one mind!

imgDesc.text: The settlement of the tribe who live alongside the Tepetlisaurs, known as the "Children of Echoes." Whether it's the clanging of artisans' hammers or the tapping of gem hunters testing the rocks, echoing sounds can be heard throughout the canyon.

Giant Solid Phlogiston Nails known as "Shadow Pins." Legend has it that the Wayob of the Children of Echoes forged them from the very flesh and blood of their tribal warriors, then hung them up high in this place to intimidate the ancient shadows of the depths below...

"Where will the struggle end, and fear lose its sway?"
"Lost, wandering souls, break free from yourselves, for ahead lies a paradise of eternal desolation."
Amidst the creeks grows a type of fruit known as the Flamegranate. It is said that all Flamegranates are merely tiny offshoots of this giant mother tree.

"Swear upon this, Xbalanque..."
"The one who ascended to realms above to protect all beings, who bestowed seeds of flame to bring light to all beings..."
"When your descendants return from the flames, none shall stop them!"

In ancient times, there was a sage who attained such mastery of the art of Phlogiston Engraving that they could transform all its many meanings into graceful drifting lines. With phlogiston as their medium, they used towering cliffs as canvases for vibrant murals. This, it is said, is the origin of Natlan graffiti as we know it now.
